units.source_text: 名人曾就业余围棋谈了一席话：“下围棋和将棋是不能了解对手性格的。

en.t: The Master once made a remark about amateur go: “You cannot understand an opponent’s character by playing go or shogi.

units.source_text: 有人说，通过对局可以看出对手的性格云云，然而从围棋的精神来看，这种说法倒是不适当。”

en.t: Some people say that a player’s character can be seen through a match and so on, but from the spirit of go, that way of speaking is actually inappropriate.”

units.source_text: 他多半是对那些一知半解而又好议论棋风的人感到气愤。

en.t: He was most likely angry at people who knew only a little yet liked to hold forth about playing style.
